Name: SDV Desktop Icon (Farm Animal Facelift)
Author: isabellam99
Description:
[b][size=4][font=Georgia]Description[/font][/size][/b]
[font=Trebuchet MS]This is simply an icon you can use to customize how Stardew Valley appears on your desktop, designed to match the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057?tab=posts][color=#b6d7a8]Farm Animal Facelift[/color][/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/siamece][color=#b6d7a8]siamece[/color][/url]. I also made a void chicken variant for anyone who might prefer a darker aesthetic![/font]

[b][size=4][font=Georgia]Instructions[/font][/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and unpack the file.[/*]
[*]This step is optional, but I recommend moving the file to [font=Courier New]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley[/font], so you don't accidentally delete it.[/*]
[*]Right-click the Stardew Valley shortcut on your desktop and select [b][color=#cfe2f3]Properties[/color][/b] (on Windows 11, you may need to click [i][color=#cfe2f3]Show more options[/color][/i] first).[/*]
[*]If it's not open already, click on the [b][color=#cfe2f3]Shortcut[/color][/b] tab.[/*]
[*]Click the [b][color=#cfe2f3]Change Icon…[/color][/b] button.[/*]
[*]Click [b][color=#cfe2f3]Browse…[/color][/b] and select the downloaded icon ([font=Courier New]Stardew-Valley-Icon.ico[/font])[/*]
[*]Click [b][color=#cfe2f3]OK[/color][/b], then click [b][color=#cfe2f3]Apply[/color][/b] (and [b][color=#cfe2f3]OK[/color][/b] again) to confirm.[/*]
[/list]Here's a [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/GG4jJ4jbyBU?si=EW0h1N93TAkxII7J][color=#b6d7a8]video[/color][/url] explaining it if you're more of a visual kinda person!
By the way, if you're playing with mods, your shortcut is probably named "StardewModdingAPI.exe". You can also rename it by right-clicking it!
